description: Implement Package CRUD API, Cross-Document Overlap Detection, and Variant Generation + Tracking. This covers Tasks 5.2 and 5.3 from the spec. Includes /api/packages endpoints, src/lib/packages/overlap.ts, and /api/generation/[id]/variants endpoint.
steps: Create src/lib/packages/overlap.ts with: (1) recordClaimUsage(packageId, generationId) - scans GenerationSpan rows and creates PackageClaimUsage entries for all claims used, (2) detectOverlap(packageId, documentType, claimIds[]) - checks which claims are already used in other documents within the same package, returns overlap report, (3) detectIntraDocumentRepetition(spans) - scans for same claimId used 3+ times within one document, returns repetition flags.
Create src/app/api/packages/route.ts with GET (list packages, filterable by jobId and status) and POST (create package with jobId, name, optional disclosureLevel).
Create src/app/api/packages/[id]/route.ts with GET (fetch package with generations and claim usages), PATCH (update name/disclosureLevel/status), DELETE.
Create src/app/api/generation/[id]/variants/route.ts with GET (list variants for a generation) and POST (choose a variant - set chosen=true, unset others).

Modify the pipeline orchestrator (src/lib/generation/pipeline.ts) post-generation stage: if a packageId is provided in options, call recordClaimUsage to create PackageClaimUsage rows. Add packageId to GenerationOptions type in types.ts.

Modify the pipeline context assembly or pre-generation stage: if packageId is provided, call detectOverlap and include the overlap report in the pipeline result. Add overlap info to PipelineResult type.

Write tests in src/lib/__tests__/packages-overlap.test.ts covering: (1) recordClaimUsage creates correct rows, (2) detectOverlap finds cross-document usage, (3) detectIntraDocumentRepetition flags 3+ uses of same claim, (4) variant selection marks chosen and unmarks others.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/packages creates a package and returns it with id
GET /api/packages returns packages filterable by jobId and status
After generation with packageId, PackageClaimUsage rows are created for every claim used
Generating a second document in same package flags already-used claims in overlap report
Intra-document repetition detection finds same claim used 3+ times
GET /api/generation/[id]/variants returns variants for a generation
POST /api/generation/[id]/variants with variantId marks it chosen and unmarks others
Tests pass for overlap detection logic
